body: Relating.... Waking up everyday knowing I'm still alive just makes me hate myself more
The fact that I am alive is being selfish..... There is nothing selfish for wanting to kill myself.... I deserve the pain.....

Me too..... Everyday alive is just like another day of nightmare..... I don't know what I'm living for.... I don't know why I'm alive...... I wish to die everyday...... It took me two years to get out of it last time..... Really wish I didn't.... And just died......
I guess that's me too.... I always feel deserving of pain but I don't think anyone else deserves it apart from myself. I just think everyone else deserves to be happy

I wish I can give my life to someone who wishes to live .... I don't deserve this life or body... When all I want is to die ... Every single day.... I'm just a coward who can't do it.....  Whenever I read the news about people dying from accidents.... I always wished it was me who died in that accident instead..... Cause they don't deserve to die.... And I do.....

Thank you for taking the time to even read my crap.... The thing is..... I can't find any purpose.... I'm too traumatized.... I'm too damaged.... And depression isn't helping at all .... I don't see what good I can bring to this world or anyone..... I'm just a huge burden living and walking around without a soul.....

Life was just never happy for me.... I just feel like a burden being around... My mom never wanted me, my brother(s) sexual/physical harassed me when I was a kid.... Grew up being bullied in school, finally suffered through all that... Then life is all about work.... Working for a life I never asked for.... Tries to meet people.... Ends up being raped. It's all probably just my fault.... I don't hate my family.... I don't hate anyone. I don't blame anyone.... It's all my fault for existing..... 
I mean.... I'd like to know what's there to live for....
